transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

I feel like certain people in my family and church are quietly working together against me, and no one believes me when I say it. My pastor recommended I talk to someone, so I agreed to come in just to keep the peace.
Besides feeling that people are working against you, have you also been hearing voices or noticing your thoughts becoming confused or hard to organize? When did these experiences first start?

No, I don't hear any voices and my thoughts aren't confused at all—I still do my job and manage my daily tasks just fine. This whole situation has been building up for about nine months now, starting right after a minor billing mistake I made at work.

Aside from feeling that people are against you, have you had any other unusual experiences like hearing voices, feeling your thoughts are being controlled, or others noticing that you’ve become emotionally flat or disorganized?

No, absolutely nothing like that. I don't hear voices, my thoughts are entirely my own, and I'm still managing my billing job, my household, and caring for my mother just fine. The only issue is the way this specific group of people is treating me.

During these past nine months, have you also had a period of feeling unusually depressed or unusually energized/high for days to weeks at a time? If so, did those mood changes start before, after, or at the same time as your belief that these people are working against you?

No, I haven't really felt unusually depressed or energized like that. My mood has been pretty much normal, aside from just feeling stressed and frustrated about what these people are doing to me. That's really the main thing on my mind.

Has anyone shown you clear proof that these people are not actually working against you, and if so, were you able to consider that you might be mistaken? Or are you completely certain this is true no matter what others say?

My family keeps telling me there's no proof and that it's all in my head, but all the little things those women do just fit together too perfectly to be a coincidence. I really want to keep the peace and wish I were wrong, but the pattern of missed texts and side comments makes me certain there is something going on.
